description:
From the fz-kdt.107 step-3 review (2026-09-01): 107.3's degrade rule
sends ANY negated or multi-positive-sig list clause to shape_only --
conservative, unmeasured. After landing, census how many corpus list
clauses degrade and whether any deserve per-clause heads (the
TupleShapes one-shape-per-clause discipline extends naturally if
the population justifies it).
title: How much head precision does the list-clause degrade rule cost?
